buildCommand: if [ -z "$DIRECT_URL" ]; then echo 'DIRECT_URL is not set for this Vercel environment — refusing to run prisma migrate deploy against the pooled DATABASE_URL. Pgbouncer transaction-mode pooling (port 6543) does not support the advisory lock migrate deploy needs, so it hangs instead of failing. Set DIRECT_URL for this environment to the session-pooler or direct connection string (port 5432).' >&2; exit 1; fi; npx prisma migrate deploy && next build
